items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The original Fat Man was Charlie Turner... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah! You know who else used to live on Prospect Avenue? Specs Powell, the drummer. He used to live on Prospect Avenue.
I know when I lived on 1218 Boston Road right after the Fat Man opened up, now I can tell you something. The original Fat Man was Charlie Turner, that's the one up on the hill.
